segments.name: Digital Banking
segments.description: Provides community, regional and super-regional financial institutions a cloud-based digital sales and service platform to onboard, engage and grow their account holders.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single operating segment and is a single-reportable segment entity.

revenueModel.text: Financial institutions pay multi-year subscription fees, predominantly per registered user, for licensed solutions on the platform, plus implementation and other services.
revenueModel.evidence: We predominantly employ a per-registered-user pricing model, with incremental fees above certain contractual client minimum commitments for each licensed solution.
